columns.name: n_sites
columns.description: Number of sites of this customer in this package.

columns.name: synthetic
columns.description: Always true: the record is invented.

reference/sites.description: Customer sites/facilities. Municipality is real geography; everything else is invented.

columns.name: sector
columns.description: Site sector (drives generation rhythm and material mix).

columns.name: billable_round_trip_km
columns.description: Round-trip distance used by contracts for transport charges.

columns.name: outdoor_material_staging
columns.description: Material is staged outdoors before compaction (rain adds water mass).

columns.name: synthetic
columns.description: Always true: the record is invented.

reference/site_calendar.description: Daily operating calendar per site (holidays, summer shutdowns, planned closures).

columns.name: is_open
columns.description: Site operates (generates material) on this date.

columns.name: public_holiday_name
columns.description: Finnish public holiday name, if any.

reference/devices.description: Fictional compactors. equipment_class uses Europress machine-type categories (COMBI, DUO); no model names, model numbers or model-specific technical data. The dataset depicts a future scenario in which most devices have integrated weighing; sensor install dates are synthetic and do not imply that weighing has been deployed in the past.

columns.name: equipment_class
columns.description: Europress machine-type category. COMBI = compactor and container permanently joined, emptied as one unit; DUO = stationary compactor, the detachable container is emptied. No model-specific data.

columns.name: active_from
columns.description: First active date within the data window (NULL = before window).

columns.name: active_to
columns.description: Last active date if decommissioned in window.

columns.name: weight_measurement
columns.description: Assumed integrated weight measurement availability (future scenario, simulated; not evidence that weighing exists today).

columns.name: on_call_threshold_pct
columns.description: Fill threshold that triggers an order (on-call).

columns.name: hybrid_skip_below_pct
columns.description: Hybrid: booked lift is skipped if fill is below this ~26 h before.

columns.name: synthetic
columns.description: Always true: the record is invented.

reference/device_installations.description: Installation history (one installation per device in v1).

columns.name: removed_on
columns.description: Removal date if removed within the window.

reference/sensor_registry.description: Simulated integrated weight sensors (future scenario). A replacement creates a new sensor id. Install dates are synthetic and do not imply that weighing has been deployed in the past. Nominal noise is a challenge simulation target (about 100 kg on a 3 t load), not a specification of any Europress weighing solution.

reference/contracts.description: HYPOTHETICAL service contracts between a customer site and a waste operator (one per device stream). Europress is currently not a party to waste transport or treatment: tariffs, processing fees and material credits are agreed between the customer and the waste operator. In a real service this is data the customer hands over to the service, or an estimate. All prices are hypothetical.

columns.name: price_index_id
columns.description: Material index used for credits (credit-eligible streams only: cardboard and plastics).

columns.name: synthetic
columns.description: Always true: the record is invented.

columns.name: note
columns.description: Status note: HYPOTHETICAL customer-operator tariff; Europress is not a party; not an actual operator contract.

reference/contract_versions.description: Customer-operator tariff versions (HYPOTHETICAL; agreed between customer and operator, Europress is not a party). In a real service this is data the customer hands over to the service or the operator shares, or an estimate. Validity [effective_from, effective_to). Integer cents / basis points for exact arithmetic. See docs/ECONOMIC_MODEL.md.

columns.name: free_km
columns.description: Km included before transport is charged.

columns.name: credit_share_bp
columns.description: Share of index price credited to the customer for credit-eligible streams (0 = operator keeps the value).

columns.name: credit_floor_cents_per_t
columns.description: Floor of the credit price before quality factor.

columns.name: rejection_fee_cents_per_t
columns.description: Reprocessing fee for rejected (grade R) credit-eligible loads.

columns.name: cancellation_fee_cents
columns.description: Fee for customer cancellation with < 24 h notice.

columns.name: wasted_trip_fee_cents
columns.description: Fee when the operator arrives but cannot lift.

columns.name: side_waste_fee_cents
columns.description: Fee when loose side waste is loaded at a lift.

columns.name: rental_cents_per_month
columns.description: Monthly equipment rental billed by the operator.

columns.name: default_weight_kg
columns.description: Contractual default billing weight when no weighbridge ticket exists.

columns.name: target_collection_cost_cents_per_t
columns.description: Site/contract benchmark for collection cost per tonne (KPI, not a price).

columns.name: weighbridge_data_shared
columns.description: Operator shares weighbridge tickets with customers at all.

columns.name: synthetic
columns.description: Always true: the record is invented.

truth/facilities.description: Fictional treatment facilities. Operator-side information: Europress does not know where the operator takes the material, so this table is not published. Public weighbridge tickets (records the operator chooses to share) carry the facility id.

reference/regions.description: Regions with illustrative distance and surcharge assumptions.

reference/price_index_monthly.description: SYNTHETIC monthly reference prices for credit-eligible streams (cardboard, plastic film, mixed plastic); not market data. Includes a cardboard value collapse and a film price spike. Material credits are agreed between customer and operator; Europress is not a party. In a real service, credit prices come from the customer's operator contract (customer-provided or operator-shared) or are an estimate.

columns.name: month
columns.description: Month the price applies to (collection month).

columns.name: price_eur_per_t
columns.description: Reference price (can be negative for mixed plastics).

columns.name: published_on
columns.description: Date the price becomes known (3rd of next month).

reference/material_classes.description: Illustrative material assumptions. Only cardboard and plastics can earn a material credit; all other streams, including paper, are chargeable to the customer.

columns.name: credit_eligible
columns.description: TRUE only for cardboard and plastics: the operator may credit the customer for material value (if the contract has a credit share). FALSE = chargeable stream: the customer pays a treatment fee.

columns.name: customer_economics
columns.description: CREDIT_ELIGIBLE (credit possible) or CHARGEABLE (customer pays treatment).

reference/quality_grade_rules.description: Operator quality grading rules for credit-eligible loads. Quality is determined only by the waste operator at its facility, using its own assessment; Europress has no technology to determine material quality before the facility.

telemetry/telemetry_hourly.description: Hourly device messages AS DELIVERED (ingest log): includes duplicates (same message_id), out-of-order and buffered delivery, gaps. Partitioned by local month of measured_at (hive key 'month').

columns.name: message_id
columns.description: Measurement id (device-hour). NOT unique: re-sent duplicates share it.

columns.name: sensor_id
columns.description: Weight sensor id; NULL if no weight sensor.

columns.name: mass_kg
columns.description: Assumed measured container mass. NULL if sensor fault or no sensor. May be negative near empty, may be drifted/biased.

columns.name: mass_uncertainty_kg
columns.description: Device-reported 1-sigma uncertainty (does not know about drift).

columns.name: press_load_index
columns.description: Generic normalised peak press load (NULL if no cycle).

columns.name: delivery_mode
columns.description: LIVE or BUFFERED (sent after a connectivity outage).

telemetry/telemetry_daily_summary.description: Per device and local date, derived ONLY from published telemetry (deduplicated by message_id).

operations/collection_events.description: Every scheduled/ordered collection event and its outcome, with device-side before/after observations.

columns.name: operator_job_ref
columns.description: Hauler's job reference; the join key to weighbridge tickets and invoice lines.

columns.name: original_trigger_type
columns.description: For RESCHEDULED events: the trigger of the event that was rescheduled; otherwise = trigger_type.

columns.name: vehicle_id
columns.description: Vehicle (from the operator ticket, if any).

columns.name: driver_reported_side_waste
columns.description: Driver loaded loose side waste (overflow) at this lift.

columns.name: driver_reported_partial
columns.description: Container could not be fully emptied.

columns.name: device_fill_pct_before
columns.description: Device fill reading for the hour before the lift (NULL if not delivered).

columns.name: device_fill_pct_after
columns.description: Device fill reading for the hour of the lift.

columns.name: device_mass_kg_before
columns.description: Valid device mass before the lift.

columns.name: device_mass_kg_after
columns.description: Valid device mass after the lift.

columns.name: device_estimated_collected_kg
columns.description: before - after; NULL if either is missing. A device-side estimate, not a weighbridge value.

columns.name: weight_reconciliation_status
columns.description: Naive pipeline status (device vs published weighbridge) computed AT EXTRACTION TIME — recompute as-of for decision features.

columns.name: invoice_match_status
columns.description: Naive exact job-ref match against invoice lines, computed AT EXTRACTION TIME.

columns.name: actual_at
columns.description: Actual service time (completed, partial, wasted trip).

operations/weighbridge_tickets.description: Operator weighbridge tickets SHARED with the customer and published before extraction (operator data, visible only when the operator shares it). Some operators never share; others share late.

columns.name: ticket_id
columns.description: Ticket (one per job; combined loads get -1/-2).

columns.name: weighing_event_id
columns.description: Physical weighing event (shared by combined loads).

columns.name: net_kg
columns.description: gross - tare of the weighing event (all loads on the vehicle).

columns.name: allocated_net_kg
columns.description: Net allocated to this job (billing basis).

columns.name: published_at
columns.description: When the ticket became available to the customer.

operations/quality_assessments.description: Operator quality grading of credit-eligible loads (published subset). The operator's own assessment at its facility; not measured by the device.

operations/maintenance_work_orders.description: Maintenance and configuration work orders (context for interpreting anomalies; not a PdM task).

finance/invoices.description: Monthly invoices sent by a fictional waste operator to the customer, per contract (issued before extraction). Customer-operator data that the customer hands over to the service; Europress is not a party. total_eur == sum(lines.amount_eur).

columns.name: dispute_status
columns.description: Customer dispute status (a dispute is not proof of an error).

columns.name: record_note
columns.description: Always: SYNTHETIC invoice from a fictional operator to a fictional customer; not a real invoice.

columns.name: synthetic
columns.description: Always true: the record is invented.

finance/invoice_lines.description: Lines of the SYNTHETIC operator-to-customer invoices: customer-operator data that the customer hands over to the service; Europress is not a party. Charges > 0, credits < 0. Matching to collections only via operator_job_ref (which may contain typos) and service_date.

columns.name: service_date
columns.description: Service date (1st of month for rental).

columns.name: quantity
columns.description: Quantity in `unit` (t with 3 decimals; pct for fuel).

columns.name: unit_price_eur
columns.description: Unit price (for FUEL_SURCHARGE: the base amount the pct applies to).

columns.name: amount_eur
columns.description: Signed amount, exact to the cent.

columns.name: synthetic
columns.description: Always true: the record is invented.

labels_dev/anomaly_labels.description: Ground-truth labels for train+validation periods (Task B). Includes explained/non-actionable labels (false-positive traps).

columns.name: is_actionable
columns.description: Whether a customer/operator action is warranted (False = explained, e.g. hygiene rule).

columns.name: value_at_stake_eur
columns.description: Illustrative value at stake (signed for billing deltas: + = overcharge).

columns.name: eval_at
columns.description: Evaluation time that defines the split: for collections max(event, issue of the invoice that bills it); otherwise event_at.

labels_dev/reference_economics.description: Reference (correct) charges per collection event from contract terms and operator billing basis (Task A answers for dev periods).

columns.name: billing_mass_kg
columns.description: Billing mass; NULL if not a lift.

columns.name: index_price_eur_per_t
columns.description: Index price of the service month.

columns.name: collection_cost_eur_per_t
columns.description: collection_cost / t; NULL if mass unknown or 0.

columns.name: total_cost_eur_per_t
columns.description: total_customer_cost / t; NULL if mass unknown or 0.

columns.name: observable_mass_source
columns.description: Best mass source a customer could see at extraction (lifts only). NONE = a correct submission reports NULL EUR/t.

columns.name: eval_at
columns.description: Evaluation time defining the split: max(event, issue of the billing invoice); extraction time if charged but not yet invoiced.

labels_dev/reference_economics_monthly.description: Reference economics aggregated per device and month (events within this package's label periods). Site-, material-, customer- and contract-level figures are group-bys of this table. Rental is excluded (monthly contract line).

labels_dev/reference_charge_lines.description: Expected invoice lines per event (dev periods).

labels_dev/decision_truth.description: Per decision case: best permissible action by simulated counterfactual (Task C, dev periods).

columns.name: best_action
columns.description: Lowest adjusted simulated cost among permissible actions.

columns.name: best_benefit_cents
columns.description: Benefit of best vs NO_ACTION over the horizon.

columns.name: acceptable_actions
columns.description: Permissible actions within tolerance of best.

columns.name: near_threshold
columns.description: Best action's benefit is within tolerance (ambiguous).

columns.name: constraint_conflict
columns.description: The raw cheapest action is not permissible.

columns.name: hidden_cost_trap_present
columns.description: Some action looks cheaper by lift count but costs more.

columns.name: tolerance_cents
columns.description: max(EUR 25, 3 % of best); an action is also acceptable within 2 paired standard errors of the best.

columns.name: truth_sensor_issue_active
columns.description: Hidden sensor issue active at decision time (VERIFY_WEIGHT_SENSOR is warranted).

columns.name: truth_invoice_overcharge_90d_eur
columns.description: Overbilling in the prior 90 days (REVIEW_INVOICES value).

labels_dev/decision_outcomes.description: Simulated counterfactual outcome of every candidate action (NOT real-world causal evidence).

columns.name: sim_cost_cents
columns.description: Simulated customer cost over horizon incl. one-off action cost.

columns.name: one_off_cost_cents
columns.description: Illustrative one-off cost of the action.

columns.name: n_replications
columns.description: Paired operational replications averaged (replication 0 = realised random stream).

columns.name: overflow_open_hours
columns.description: Mean hours the container was full while the site was open.

columns.name: max_interval_violations
columns.description: Mean number of intervals exceeding max days + 1.

columns.name: end_state_mass_kg
columns.description: Mass left in container + side stock at horizon end.

columns.name: terminal_value_cents_per_kg
columns.description: Contract-based marginal cost used to value end-state mass differences.

columns.name: adjusted_cost_sd_cents
columns.description: Std. dev. of adjusted cost across replications.

columns.name: benefit_vs_no_action_cents
columns.description: Mean paired NO_ACTION adjusted cost minus this.

columns.name: benefit_se_cents
columns.description: Standard error of the paired benefit.

columns.name: diff_to_best_se_cents
columns.description: Standard error of the paired difference to the best permissible action.

columns.name: naive_lift_saving_cents
columns.description: Saving estimated from lift count alone (naive).

columns.name: hidden_cost_trap
columns.description: Naive saving > EUR 50 but real benefit < 0.

truth/truth_hourly_state.description: PRIVATE simulator ground truth per device-hour. Never a model input.

columns.description: Mass in container at hour end.

truth/weighbridge_all.description: PRIVATE: all tickets incl. unshared/unpublished, with tare error and true net.

truth/invoice_line_labels.description: PRIVATE: every injected billing discrepancy (line-level and missing/uninvoiced).

columns.name: median_share_lag_days
